result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A assigns one clear version to each placement, gives a minimum size for each, and tells the designer when to switch to the symbol-only version. B is more detailed, but it gives wrong or confusing tote guidance: it says to keep the mark 'within' 2 in of the seams and to fill gaps wider than 1/16 in. It also leaves the tote layout undecided and gives no minimum size for the full lockup, only a 16 px check. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B gives clearer protection rules: clear space of x, a minimum size for each placement, and an explicit point where the header switches to symbol-only. Its tote advice on one color, removing fine detail and keeping gaps wide is sound. A is detailed but has some confusing or backwards instructions: it says to keep the tote mark 'within' 2 in of the seams, gives a muddled gap-filling rule, and mixes up its dark-canvas note. A also never sets a minimum size for the full lockup.
